result: Typed PtyCommand/PtyEvent contract with exact AttachmentKey, WorkSurfaceId, run generation, and monotonic sequence on every event. Full command surface attach/input/resize/interrupt/detach/close/restart; evaluatePtyOutput defines stale-output rejection (stale generation or non-monotonic sequence); monotonic factories. Store envelope now carries the full flat attachment key and converts PiNativeCommand to PtyCommand; Pi stays alive per PTY-001 singleton. Ordinary child-process pipes are never used.
